condition: On some sparse directed graphs (for example, diamond chains), simple_cycles with a length_bound takes exponential time even when it finds no cycles or only a few, because _bounded_cycle_search prunes too loosely.
workaround: Use a bounded DFS that drops successors failing a reverse-BFS reachability test (SimpleSearch, or BS-DFS from the thread), or upgrade once PR #8942 is merged.
